title: Harness surface
text: Harness surface is not a stored level-row field. Launchable on chips show the viewer's own standing: only projects they may operate and machines they may use contribute eligible surfaces. Missing surfaces appear once below all levels with actionable machine-specific reasons. Native listings and catalog selection still determine which models each eligible surface can launch.
evidence: Viewer access and unavailable reasons checked in runtime/api/domain/test_universe_level_capacity_read.py and runtime/api/universe_ui_levels.test.mjs. Previous production QA run 45473 / artifact 32323 proves the earlier chips, not viewer-specific access. Production re-verification is attached as viewer-level-standing-prod.
